                "source_hash": h, "verified": None,
                "sha256": {k: pio.file_sha256(v) for k, v in res.artifacts.items()},
            }
            mf = self.project.register_build(res.artifacts, manifest)
            self.state["build_version"] = mf["version"]
            out["version"] = mf["version"]
            self.project.update_meta(last_build={**(self.project.meta().get("last_build") or {}), "version": mf["version"]})
            out["hex_available"] = "hex" in res.artifacts
            self.session.emit("build_result", result=out, manifest=mf)
        else:
            self.session.emit("build_result", result=out, manifest=None)
        out.pop("log_tail", None) if res.ok else None
        return out

    def verify(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        meta = self.project.meta()
        chip = f"{meta.get('mcu') or ''} {meta.get('board') or ''} {meta.get('bf_target') or ''}"
        pico = bool(re.search(r"RP2[03]", chip, re.I))
        rep = verify_project(self.project.root, self.ledger, pico=pico, chip=chip.strip())
        if self._is_betaflight():
            from embedforge.truth import betaflight_rp2350
            from embedforge.truth.verifier import Finding
            board = eda.load_board(self.project.root)
            for cfg in betaflight.config_files(self.project.root):
                rel = str(cfg.relative_to(self.project.root)).replace("\\", "/")
                text = cfg.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
                for f in betaflight_rp2350.check_config(text, meta.get("bf_target") or ""):
                    rep.findings.append(Finding(f["severity"], f["code"], rel, f["line"], f["message"], suggestion=f["suggestion"]))
                for sev, code, ln, msg, sug in betaflight.board_consistency(text, board):
                    rep.findings.append(Finding(sev, code, rel, ln, msg, suggestion=sug))
                own = {}  # name -> line; names the config itself tests (#ifdef X) are its own switches
                for i, raw in enumerate(text.split("\n"), start=1):
                    dm = re.match(r"\s*#\s*define\s+([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]+)", raw)
                    if dm:
                        own.setdefault(dm.group(1), i)
                tested = set(re.findall(r"#\s*(?:if|ifdef|ifndef|elif)\b[^\n]*?\b([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]+)", text))
                for name in betaflight.unknown_defines([n for n in own if n not in tested]) or []:
                    pin_like = name.endswith(("_PIN", "_INSTANCE"))
                    rep.findings.append(Finding(
                        "ERROR" if pin_like else "WARNING", "UNKNOWN_DEFINE", rel, own[name],
                        f"{name} is not used anywhere in Betaflight {betaflight.BF_TAG}, so it has no effect"
                        + (" — that function is not configured." if pin_like else "."),
                        suggestion=(f"Use the define name Betaflight reads (search_framework('{name.split('_')[0]}_') or a reference "
                                    "config); e.g. motors are MOTOR1_PIN..MOTOR8_PIN, gyros USE_ACCGYRO_<CHIP> or USE_GYRO_SPI_<CHIP>.")))
            rep.passed = not any(f.severity == "ERROR" for f in rep.findings)
        rep.findings += self._unread_sections(rep)
        rep.findings += self._compiler_findings()
        rep.passed = not any(f.severity == "ERROR" for f in rep.findings)
        h = self.source_hash()
        inputs = self.verify_inputs_hash()
        self.state.update(verify_hash=h, verify_ok=rep.passed, verify_inputs=inputs)
        # stamp the matching build manifest
        if self.state.get("build_hash") == h and self.state.get("build_version"):
            import json
            mf_path = self.project.root / "builds" / f"v{self.state['build_version']}" / "manifest.json"
            if mf_path.exists():
                mf = json.loads(mf_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                mf["verified"] = rep.passed
                mf["verification_summary"] = rep.summary()
                write_atomic(mf_path, json.dumps(mf, indent=2))
                self.session.emit("build_manifest", manifest=mf)
        pub = rep.public()
        self.session.emit("verify", report=pub, summary=rep.summary())
        import json
        # the whole report, so the IDE shows the evidence (findings, traceability, sequences) when the project is reopened
        (self.project.root / "verify_report.json").write_text(
            json.dumps({"hash": h, "summary": rep.summary(), "report": pub}, default=str), encoding="utf-8")
        prev_inputs = (meta.get("last_verify") or {}).get("inputs")
        findings = self._compact_findings(pub["findings"])
        flows = [{"sequence": f["sequence"], "subject": f["subject"], "name": f["name"], "entry": f["entry"],
                  "steps": [f"{s['step']}. {s['op']}: {s['status']}" + (f" ({s['file']}:{s['line']})" if s.get("line") else "")
                            for s in f["steps"]]} for f in pub.get("flows", [])[:6]]
        self.project.update_meta(last_verify={
            "hash": h, "inputs": inputs, "passed": rep.passed, "summary": rep.summary(),
            "findings": [f"{x.get('code')} {x.get('file')}:{x.get('line') or x.get('lines')} {str(x.get('message'))[:140]}"
                         for x in findings[:5]],
        })
        out: Dict[str, Any] = {"passed": rep.passed, "summary": rep.summary(), "findings": findings}
        if flows:
            out["flows"] = flows  # each datasheet sequence, step by step, as found in the code
        regs = pub.get("registers") or {}
        if regs.get("writes") or regs.get("formulas"):
            # what the code's register values mean, per the recorded register map, and which formulas it implements
            out["meaning"] = {"register_writes": regs.get("writes", [])[:12], "formulas": regs.get("formulas", [])[:16]}
            if regs.get("constraints"):
                out["meaning"]["constraints"] = regs["constraints"][:8]
        if prev_inputs == inputs:
            out["unchanged"] = True  # same sources and facts as the last verify: same answer, not progress
        shown = sum(len(x.get("lines") or [1]) for x in findings)
        if len(pub["findings"]) > shown:
            out["note"] = f"{len(pub['findings']) - shown} more findings not shown; fix these first."
        return out

    def _compact_findings(self, findings: List[Dict[str, Any]], cap: int = 12) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Errors first; 3+ findings with the same code and message pattern collapse into one entry with their lines;
        untraced pins get the schematic line(s) that could justify them."""
        order = {"ERROR": 0, "WARNING": 1, "INFO": 2}
        findings = sorted(findings, key=lambda f: order.get(f.get("severity"), 3))
        groups: Dict[tuple, List[Dict[str, Any]]] = {}
        for f in findings:  # only findings that say the same thing collapse (pin numbers, line numbers and fact ids ignored)
            shape = re.sub(r"\b(?:PA|GPIO|FACT-)?\d+\b", "#", str(f.get("message") or ""))
            groups.setdefault((f.get("severity"), f.get("code"), f.get("file"), shape), []).append(f)
        board = eda.load_board(self.project.root) if (self.project.root / "board.json").exists() else None
        sid = self.store._by_url.get(eda.BOARD_SOURCE_URL)
        out: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        for (sev, code, file, _shape), fs in groups.items():
            if len(fs) >= 3 and code not in ("UNSOURCED_CONSTANT", "FACT_VALUE_MISMATCH"):
                out.append({"severity": sev, "code": code, "file": file, "lines": [f.get("line") for f in fs][:30],
                            "message": f"{len(fs)}x: {str(fs[0].get('message'))[:200]}",
                            "suggestion": str(fs[0].get("suggestion") or "")[:200]})
                continue
            for f in fs:
                g = {k: v for k, v in f.items() if k in ("severity", "code", "file", "line", "message", "literal")}
                # a finding about one line gets a short hint; one about the whole project (what to read, which rules to
                # record) is few and its steps are the point: cut at 200 characters, the BMP388 runs never saw 'then
                # resolve_requirements with ref = that record' and re-read the datasheet instead
                g["suggestion"] = str(f.get("suggestion") or "")[:200 if f.get("file") else 1500]
                m = re.fullmatch(r"PA?(\d{1,2})|GPIO(\d{1,2})", str(f.get("literal") or ""))
                if board is not None and m and code in ("UNSOURCED_CONSTANT", "UNTAGGED_CONSTANT", "FACT_VALUE_MISMATCH"):
                    gpio = int(next(x for x in m.groups() if x))
                    lines = board.mcu_pin_lines(gpio)[:2]
                    if lines and all(ln.rstrip().endswith("not connected") for ln in lines):
                        g["suggestion"] = f"GPIO{gpio} is not connected on the schematic: remove this define."
                    elif lines:
                        g["board_lines"] = lines
                        g["suggestion"] = (f"Only if this net is what the define drives: record_board_pins(pins=[{{define:"
                                           f"'<DEFINE>', line:<a board_lines entry>}}]) (source {sid}); otherwise fix the pin.")
                out.append(g)
        return out[:cap]

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ control
    def set_plan(self, markdown: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        (self.project.root / "artifacts").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        (self.project.root / "artifacts" / "task.md").write_text(markdown, encoding="utf-8")
        self.session.emit("plan", markdown=markdown)
        return {"ok": True}

    def ask_user(self, question: str, missing: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        self.ended = "ask_user"
        self.final = {"question": question, "missing": missing or []}
        return {"ok": True, "note": "Waiting for the user."}

    def finish(self, status: str, summary: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        h = self.source_hash()
        if status == "success":
            problems = []
            if not (self.state["build_ok"] and self.state["build_hash"] == h):
                problems.append("current sources have no successful build (call build)")
            if not (self.state["verify_ok"] and self.state["verify_hash"] == h):
                problems.append("current sources have no passing verify (call verify)")
            elif self.state.get("verify_inputs") != self.verify_inputs_hash():
                problems.append("facts, sequences, the schematic or the verify rules changed after the last verify (call "
                                "verify again)")
            if problems:
                return {"error": "Cannot finish with success: " + "; ".join(problems) + "."}
        false = self._unsupported_claims(summary or "", h)
        if false:  # any status: a 'blocked' summary may not claim a build or a verify that did not happen either
            return {"error": "The summary claims " + "; ".join(false) + ". Rewrite it to say exactly what was built and verified "
                             "(and what was not), then call finish again."}
        self.ended = "finish"
        self.final = {"status": status, "summary": summary}
        return {"ok": True}

    def _unsupported_claims(self, summary: str, h: str) -> List[str]:
        built = bool(self.state["build_ok"] and self.state["build_hash"] == h)
        verified = bool(self.state["verify_ok"] and self.state["verify_hash"] == h and self.state.get("verify_inputs") == self.verify_inputs_hash())
        text = re.sub(r"\b(not|never|un|could not|couldn't|cannot|can't|failed to|fails?|without|nothing\s+(?:was|is|has been|got)|"
                      r"no(?:thing)?\s+(?:code|firmware|part)?\s*(?:was|is|has been))\s+(yet\s+|been\s+|be\s+)?(fully\s+)?",
                      "NOT_", summary, flags=re.I)
        out = []
        if not verified and re.search(r"(?<!NOT_)\b(verified|verification passed|passe[sd] verif\w*|verify passe[sd])\b", text, re.I):
            out.append("the code is verified, but the current sources have no passing verify")
        if not built and re.search(r"(?<!NOT_)\b(built|builds|compiled|compiles)\b(?!\s+(?:yet|fails|failed))", text, re.I):
            out.append("the code is built, but the current sources have no successful build")
        if re.search(r"(?<!NOT_)\b(tested on (the )?(hardware|board)|flashed|works on the board|flies|flight[- ]tested)\b", text, re.I):
            out.append("hardware testing, which EmbedForge never does (no device evidence)")
        return out
embedforge/agent/vision.py:
"""Reading datasheet figures: find the page of a figure in the stored PDF, render it, and have a vision model
transcribe it into text (sequences in order, labels, values, arrows). Datasheets put rules in figures that text
extraction loses (the BMP388's 'write settings, then select normal mode' is a timing diagram); only the figures of the
sections the code depends on are read, so a 100-page datasheet costs a few calls."""

import base64
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Callable, Optional, Tuple

FIGURE_PROMPT = (
    "This is a page of a component datasheet. Transcribe the figure or table captioned \"{caption}\" into text, "
    "exactly as drawn: for a timing or sequence diagram, every step in order with its condition, register or field "
    "values and times, and what each span or arrow marks from where to where; for a state or mode diagram, every state, "
    "then every transition as FROM -> TO: trigger, following the arrowheads (write 'direction unclear' where an "
    "arrowhead cannot be seen); for a table, its rows. Copy labels, symbols (Greek letters) and letter case exactly. "
    "Do not add anything the figure does not show. If other figures are in the image too, transcribe only that one. "
    "Plain text or Markdown only.")


def _norm(s: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s or "").strip().lower()


def find_page(pdf_path: Path, label: str, caption: str, hint: int = 0) -> int:
    """1-based page whose text carries the caption ('Figure 3' + its first words); 0 when none does."""
    import pymupdf
    want_label, want_cap = _norm(label), _norm(caption)[:24]
    with pymupdf.open(str(pdf_path)) as doc:
        order = ([hint - 1] if 0 < hint <= doc.page_count else []) + [i for i in range(doc.page_count) if i != hint - 1]
        for i in order:
            text = _norm(doc[i].get_text())
            if want_label in text and want_cap in text:
                return i + 1
    return 0


def render_page(pdf_path: Path, page: int, dpi: int = 130) -> bytes:
    import pymupdf
    with pymupdf.open(str(pdf_path)) as doc:
        return doc[page - 1].get_pixmap(dpi=dpi).tobytes("png")


_CAPTION_START = re.compile(r"^(?:figure|fig\.|table)\s+\d{1,3}\s*[:.]")


def figure_clip(page, label: str):
    """The part of the page that holds the figure, so a model is not shown the one next to it (the BMP388's forced and
    normal mode diagrams share a page and differ in one value). A figure's caption is under it: the clip runs up to the
    paragraph or caption above. A table's caption is over it: down to the next caption. None: use the whole page."""
    import pymupdf
    blocks = [b for b in page.get_text("blocks") if b[6] == 0]
    want = _norm(label)
    cap = next((b for b in blocks if re.match(re.escape(want) + r"\s*[:.]", _norm(b[4]))), None)
    if cap is None:
        return None
    width, height = page.rect.width, page.rect.height
    if want.startswith("table"):
        below = [b[1] for b in blocks if b is not cap and b[1] >= cap[3] and _CAPTION_START.match(_norm(b[4]))]
        top, bottom = cap[1], min(below, default=height)
    else:   # body text is wide, labels in a drawing are not
        above = [b[3] for b in blocks if b is not cap and b[3] <= cap[1] + 1
                 and (_CAPTION_START.match(_norm(b[4])) or b[2] - b[0] >= 0.6 * width)]
        top, bottom = max(above, default=0), cap[3]
    if bottom - top < 60:
        return None
    return pymupdf.Rect(0, top, width, min(height, bottom + 4))


def render_figure(pdf_path: Path, page: int, label: str) -> bytes:
    """The figure cut from its page at 170 dpi (subscripts stay legible), or the whole page when it cannot be cut."""
    import pymupdf
    with pymupdf.open(str(pdf_path)) as doc:
        p = doc[page - 1]
        clip = figure_clip(p, label)
        return p.get_pixmap(dpi=170 if clip else 130, clip=clip).tobytes("png")


def default_reader() -> Tuple[Callable[[str, bytes], str], str]:
    """(prompt, png) -> text with the configured vision model (EMBEDFORGE_VISION_PROVIDER / _MODEL), and its name."""
    from embedforge.agent.llm import AgentLLM
    from embedforge.core.config import config
    llm = AgentLLM(config.vision_model, config.vision_provider)

    def ask(prompt: str, png: bytes) -> str:
        url = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(png).decode("ascii")
        msg = {"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": prompt}, {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": url}}]}
        # reasoning models think before they answer: room for both, or the transcription comes back empty
        return llm.chat([msg], None, max_tokens=16384, retries=3)["content"]
    return ask, llm.model


def transcribe(pdf_path: Path, label: str, caption: str, hint: int = 0,
               reader: Optional[Callable[[str, bytes], str]] = None) -> Tuple[str, int]:
    """(transcription, page) of a figure; ('', 0) when its page is not found."""
    page = find_page(pdf_path, label, caption, hint)
    if not page:
        return "", 0
    ask = reader or default_reader()[0]
    return ask(FIGURE_PROMPT.format(caption=f"{label}: {caption}"), render_figure(pdf_path, page, label)).strip(), page

"""Crash-safe writes for a project's records. A server stopped mid-write (a closed terminal, a killed process) used to
leave a truncated file: a run's read log came back as 316 blank bytes, and the same could empty the fact ledger. The
text goes to a temporary file next to the target, is flushed to disk, and replaces the target in one step, so a
reader sees the old file or the new one, never half of one."""

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

# flush to the disk before the swap, so a power cut keeps the file too (about 10 ms a write on Windows; the test suite,
# which writes thousands of records, turns it off)
FSYNC = True


def write_atomic(path: Path, text: str, encoding: str = "utf-8") -> None:
    path = Path(path)
    tmp = path.with_name(f".{path.name}.tmp")
    with open(tmp, "w", encoding=encoding) as f:   # newlines as Path.write_text writes them
        f.write(text)
        if FSYNC:
            f.flush()
            os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.replace(tmp, path)


def load_json(path: Path, default: Any) -> Any:
    """The parsed file, or default when there is none. A file that does not parse is moved aside to <name>.corrupt
    (the next save would otherwise overwrite what is left of it, silently) and default is returned."""
    path = Path(path)
    try:
        return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return default
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        try:
            os.replace(path, path.with_name(path.name + ".corrupt"))
        except OSError:
            pass
        from embedforge.core.logger import logger
        logger.log_event("CORRUPT_FILE", f"{path} did not parse; kept as {path.name}.corrupt")
        return default

"""Structured logging and audit trail for EmbedForge."""

import sys
import logging
from typing import Any, Dict
from rich.console import Console
from rich.theme import Theme

# Set standard streams to utf-8 if possible
if hasattr(sys.stdout, "reconfigure"):
    try:
        sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    except Exception:
        pass

custom_theme = Theme({
    "info": "cyan",
    "warning": "yellow",
    "error": "bold red",
    "success": "bold green",
    "provenance": "bold magenta",
    "hardware": "bold blue"
})

console = Console(theme=custom_theme, safe_box=True)

class EmbedForgeLogger:
    """Structured console and file logger with provenance highlighting."""
    def __init__(self, name: str = "embedforge"):
        self.logger = logging.getLogger(name)
        if not self.logger.handlers:
            handler = logging.StreamHandler()
            formatter = logging.Formatter(
                fmt="[%(asctime)s] [%(levelname)s] [%(name)s] %(message)s",
                datefmt="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"
            )
            handler.setFormatter(formatter)
            self.logger.addHandler(handler)
            self.logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

    def log_event(self, stage: str, message: str, metadata: Dict[str, Any] = None):
        meta_str = f" | {metadata}" if metadata else ""
        console.print(f"[bold cyan][{stage}][/bold cyan] {message}{meta_str}")

    def log_provenance(self, artifact_id: str, source: str, claim: str):
        console.print(f"[provenance]PROVENANCE [{artifact_id}][/provenance] Source: {source} -> Claim: '{claim}'")

    def log_gap(self, gap_id: str, description: str):
        console.print(f"[warning]GAP DETECTED [{gap_id}][/warning] {description}")

    def log_approval(self, resource_id: str, approved: bool, reviewer: str = "Human"):
        status = "[success]APPROVED[/success]" if approved else "[error]REJECTED[/error]"
        console.print(f"RESOURCE GATE [{resource_id}]: {status} by {reviewer}")

    def log_finding(self, finding_id: str, classification: str, detail: str):
        color = "error" if "MISMATCH" in classification else "warning"
        console.print(f"[{color}]VERIFICATION [{finding_id}] ({classification})[/{color}] {detail}")

logger = EmbedForgeLogger()

"""Information gap detector for embedded hardware requirements."""

import re
from typing import List, Set
from embedforge.models.requirement import RequirementItem, InformationGap

class RequirementGapDetector:
    """Detects missing embedded specifications and flags them as information gaps."""

    def detect_gaps(self, source_text: str, items: List[RequirementItem]) -> List[InformationGap]:
        gaps: List[InformationGap] = []
        gap_id = 1

        # Check explicit facts present
        explicit_keys: Set[str] = set()
        components_found: List[str] = []

        for item in items:
            for k, v in item.explicit_facts.items():
                explicit_keys.add(k)
                if k == "target_component":
                    components_found.append(v)

        # 1. Target Sensor/IC identification gap
        if not components_found:
            gaps.append(InformationGap(
                id=f"GAP-{gap_id:03d}",
                gap_type="MISSING_TARGET_DEVICE",
                target_subject="HARDWARE",
                target_property="sensor_or_ic_model",
                description="No specific sensor or peripheral IC model was named in the requirement.",
                criticality="CRITICAL",
                suggested_search_terms=["embedded sensor components"]
            ))
            gap_id += 1

        MCU_PREFIXES = ("STM32", "AT32", "ESP32", "RP2040", "ATMEGA", "ATTINY", "NRF52", "NRF53", "SAMD", "CH32", "PIC", "GD32", "MSP430", "LPC")
        GATE_DRIVER_PREFIXES = ("FD6288", "IR210", "DRV8", "A4988", "TMC22", "L298", "L293", "TC44", "MOSFET", "GATE", "BRIDGE", "ESC")

        # For each identified IC, detect peripheral-level engineering gaps
        for comp in components_found:
            ucomp = comp.upper()
            if re.match(r"^P[A-Z]\d+$", ucomp) or re.match(r"^GPIO\d+$", ucomp):
                continue
            is_mcu = any(p in ucomp for p in MCU_PREFIXES)
            is_gate_driver = any(p in ucomp for p in GATE_DRIVER_PREFIXES)

            # MCUs are host processors: they do not have I2C slave addresses or peripheral sensor register maps
            if is_mcu:
                continue

            # Discrete gate drivers & motor bridges: controlled directly via GPIO/PWM, no I2C/SPI slave address or register map
            if is_gate_driver:
                if "bus_interface" not in explicit_keys and not any(k in source_text.upper() for k in ("PWM", "GPIO")):
                    gaps.append(InformationGap(
                        id=f"GAP-{gap_id:03d}",
                        gap_type="MISSING_PWM_CONTROL",
                        target_subject=comp,
                        target_property="pwm_control_scheme",
                        description=f"Control interface (complementary PWM channels, dead-time) for gate driver {comp} is not specified.",
                        criticality="HIGH",
                        suggested_search_terms=[f"{comp} complementary PWM dead time pinout"]
                    ))
                    gap_id += 1
                continue

            # Standard digital peripheral / sensor (e.g. MPU6050, BME280)
            # Check bus interface
            if "bus_interface" not in explicit_keys:
                gaps.append(InformationGap(
                    id=f"GAP-{gap_id:03d}",
                    gap_type="MISSING_INTERFACE_PROTOCOL",
                    target_subject=comp,
                    target_property="bus_interface",
                    description=f"Communication bus interface (I2C, SPI, UART) for {comp} is not specified.",
                    criticality="HIGH",
                    suggested_search_terms=[f"{comp} datasheet communication interface"]
                ))
                gap_id += 1

            # Check I2C / SPI address or chip-select
            if "hex_address_or_reg" not in explicit_keys:
                gaps.append(InformationGap(
                    id=f"GAP-{gap_id:03d}",
                    gap_type="MISSING_DEVICE_ADDRESS",
                    target_subject=comp,
                    target_property="device_address",
                    description=f"Hardware device address / default I2C address for {comp} is missing.",
                    criticality="CRITICAL",
                    suggested_search_terms=[f"{comp} default I2C address register map datasheet"]
                ))
                gap_id += 1

            # Check Register Map & Initialization Sequence
            gaps.append(InformationGap(
                id=f"GAP-{gap_id:03d}",
                gap_type="MISSING_REGISTER_MAP",
                target_subject=comp,
                target_property="register_map",
                description=f"Register map, WHO_AM_I register, and power management registers for {comp} are unverified.",
                criticality="HIGH",
                suggested_search_terms=[f"{comp} register map power management WHO_AM_I reset"]
            ))
            gap_id += 1

            # Check Power-up Delay & Sampling limits
            if "timing_spec" not in explicit_keys:
                gaps.append(InformationGap(
                    id=f"GAP-{gap_id:03d}",
                    gap_type="MISSING_TIMING_SPEC",
                    target_subject=comp,
                    target_property="sampling_rate_and_delays",
                    description=f"Operating frequency, sampling rate, and reset delay timing for {comp} are not specified.",
                    criticality="MEDIUM",
                    suggested_search_terms=[f"{comp} max clock speed startup time delay"]
                ))
                gap_id += 1

        return gaps

"""Requirement parser extracting strictly explicit facts without invention."""

import re
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional
from embedforge.models.requirement import (
    RequirementSet, RequirementItem, RequirementCategory, InformationGap
)
from embedforge.engines.requirements.gap_detector import RequirementGapDetector

class RequirementParser:
    """Parses natural language requirements into structured explicit items and detects gaps."""

    def parse(self, user_request: str) -> RequirementSet:
        req_items: List[RequirementItem] = []
        item_counter = 1

        # Explicit regex patterns for extracting stated facts without hallucination
        patterns = [
            (
                RequirementCategory.INTERFACE,
                r"\b(I2C|SPI|UART|USART|CAN|USB|ADC|PWM|GPIO)\b",
                "bus_interface"
            ),
            (
                RequirementCategory.TIMING,
                r"\b(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(Hz|kHz|MHz|ms|us|seconds|sec)\b",
                "timing_spec"
            ),
            (
                RequirementCategory.POWER,
                r"\b(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(V|mV|mA|uA)\b",
                "voltage_or_current"
            ),
            (
                RequirementCategory.HARDWARE_PIN,
                r"\b(PA\d+|PB\d+|PC\d+|PD\d+|P\d+_\d+|pin\s*\d+|GPIO\d+)\b",
                "pin_reference"
            ),
            (
                RequirementCategory.CONSTRAINT,
                r"\b(0x[0-9A-Fa-f]{2,4})\b",
                "hex_address_or_reg"
            )
        ]

        extracted_facts: Dict[str, Any] = {}
        seen_facts = set()

        # Scan for explicit facts
        for cat, pat, fact_key in patterns:
            matches = re.finditer(pat, user_request, re.IGNORECASE)
            for m in matches:
                val = m.group(0)
                dedup_key = (cat, fact_key, val.upper())
                if dedup_key in seen_facts:
                    continue
                seen_facts.add(dedup_key)
                extracted_facts[fact_key] = val
                req_items.append(RequirementItem(
                    id=f"REQ-{item_counter:03d}",
                    category=cat,
                    description=f"Explicit {fact_key.replace('_', ' ')} specified: {val}",
                    explicit_facts={fact_key: val},
                    raw_source_phrase=m.group(0)
                ))
                item_counter += 1

        # Look for chip/sensor keywords explicitly mentioned in source text (e.g. MPU6050, BME280, STM32F401, ESP32)
        chip_pattern = r"\b([A-Z0-9]{3,}-[A-Z0-9]+|[A-Z]{2,}\d{2,}[A-Z0-9]*)\b"
        for m in re.finditer(chip_pattern, user_request):
            token = m.group(0)
            utoken = token.upper()
            if utoken in {"UART", "USART", "GPIO", "CAN", "PWM", "ADC", "DMA", "HAL", "SDK", "API"}:
                continue
            if re.match(r"^P[A-Z]\d+$", utoken) or re.match(r"^GPIO\d+$", utoken):
                continue
            dedup_key = (RequirementCategory.FUNCTIONAL, "target_component", utoken)
            if dedup_key in seen_facts:
                continue
            seen_facts.add(dedup_key)
            req_items.append(RequirementItem(
                id=f"REQ-{item_counter:03d}",
                category=RequirementCategory.FUNCTIONAL,
                description=f"Explicit target component identified: {token}",
                explicit_facts={"target_component": token},
                raw_source_phrase=token
            ))
            item_counter += 1

        # Always run gap detector to identify missing essential hardware parameters
        gap_detector = RequirementGapDetector()
        gaps = gap_detector.detect_gaps(user_request, req_items)

        return RequirementSet(
            id="REQ-001",
            source_text=user_request,
            requirements=req_items,
            information_gaps=gaps,
            status="PARSED"
        )

"""Requirement data contracts."""

from enum import Enum
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class RequirementCategory(str, Enum):
    FUNCTIONAL = "FUNCTIONAL"
    INTERFACE = "INTERFACE"
    TIMING = "TIMING"
    CONSTRAINT = "CONSTRAINT"
    POWER = "POWER"

class RequirementItem(BaseModel):
    id: str

class InformationGap(BaseModel):
    id: str
    gap_type: str

    target_property: str

    suggested_search_terms: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)

class RequirementSet(BaseModel):
    id: str = "REQ-001"
    source_text: str
    requirements: List[RequirementItem] = Field(default_factory=list)
    information_gaps: List[InformationGap] = Field(default_factory=list)

    created_at: datetime = Field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))
embedforge/runlog.py:
"""Which provider and model every agent run used, and what it cost, read from each project's trace.jsonl (every run
records its provider, model, sampling and harness version at run_start, the token usage and model time of each step,
and its outcome at run_end).

  python -m embedforge.runlog              # per provider and model: runs, steps, tokens, model time, verified outcomes
  python -m embedforge.runlog --markdown   # the same as a Markdown table (README)
  python -m embedforge.runlog --runs       # one line per run
"""

import collections
import datetime
import json
import statistics
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List

from embedforge.core.config import config


def runs(projects_dir: Path) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    out = []
    for tr in sorted(Path(projects_dir).glob("*/trace.jsonl")):
        events = []
        for line in tr.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").splitlines():
            try:
                events.append(json.loads(line))
            except ValueError:
                continue
        starts = [i for i, e in enumerate(events) if e.get("event") == "run_start"] + [len(events)]
        for i, nxt in zip(starts, starts[1:]):
            e, body = events[i], events[i + 1:nxt]   # a run's events end where the next run starts
            # the last end: a second server started on a busy port once wrote a false 'interrupted' end mid-run
            end = next((x for x in reversed(body) if x.get("event") == "run_end"), {})
            steps = [x for x in body if "step" in x and "usage" in x]
            usage = [x.get("usage") or {} for x in steps]
            out.append({"t": e.get("t", 0), "project": tr.parent.name, "provider": e.get("provider") or "?",
                        "model": e.get("model") or "?", "harness": e.get("harness", ""),
                        "status": end.get("status") or "interrupted", "steps": end.get("steps", len(steps)),
                        "built": end.get("build_ok"), "verified": end.get("verify_ok"),
                        "prompt_tokens": sum(int(u.get("prompt_tokens") or 0) for u in usage),
                        "completion_tokens": sum(int(u.get("completion_tokens") or 0) for u in usage),
                        "model_seconds": sum(float(x.get("llm_seconds") or 0) for x in steps)})
    return sorted(out, key=lambda r: r["t"])


def by_model(rs: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Per provider and model: runs, the runs that ended built and verified, steps, tokens and model time."""
    groups: Dict[tuple, List[Dict[str, Any]]] = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for r in rs:
        groups[(r["provider"], r["model"])].append(r)
    out = []
    for (p, m), g in sorted(groups.items(), key=lambda kv: -len(kv[1])):
        steps = [int(r["steps"] or 0) for r in g]
        n_steps = max(1, sum(steps))
        out.append({"provider": p, "model": m, "runs": len(g), "first": g[0]["t"], "last": g[-1]["t"],
                    "verified": sum(1 for r in g if r["built"] and r["verified"]),
                    "steps": sum(steps), "median_steps": statistics.median(steps) if steps else 0,
                    "prompt_tokens": sum(r["prompt_tokens"] for r in g), "completion_tokens": sum(r["completion_tokens"] for r in g),
                    "seconds_per_step": sum(r["model_seconds"] for r in g) / n_steps,
                    "prompt_per_step": sum(r["prompt_tokens"] for r in g) / n_steps})
    return out


def main() -> None:
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
    rs = runs(Path(config.workspace_root) / "workspace" / "projects")
    day = lambda t: datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(t).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    if "--runs" in sys.argv:
        for r in rs:
            print(f"{datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(r['t']):%Y-%m-%d %H:%M}  {r['provider']:10} {r['model']:42} "
                  f"{str(r['status']):12} steps={r['steps']} built={r['built']} verified={r['verified']} "
                  f"tokens={r['prompt_tokens']}+{r['completion_tokens']}  {r['project']}")
        return
    rows = by_model(rs)
    if "--markdown" in sys.argv:
        print("| Provider | Model | Runs | Ended built + verified | Steps (median per run) | Prompt + completion tokens "
              "| Model time per step | Dates |")
        print("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
        for g in rows:
            print(f"| {g['provider']} | {g['model']} | {g['runs']} | {g['verified']} | {g['steps']} ({g['median_steps']:g}) | "
                  f"{g['prompt_tokens'] / 1e6:.1f}M + {g['completion_tokens'] / 1e3:.0f}k | {g['seconds_per_step']:.0f} s | "
                  f"{day(g['first'])} to {day(g['last'])} |")
        return
    print(f"{len(rs)} agent runs")
    for g in rows:
        print(f"  {g['provider']:10} {g['model']:42} {g['runs']:4} runs  {day(g['first'])} .. {day(g['last'])}  "
              f"built + verified: {g['verified']}  steps: {g['steps']} (median {g['median_steps']:g})  "
              f"tokens: {g['prompt_tokens'] / 1e6:.1f}M + {g['completion_tokens'] / 1e3:.0f}k  "
              f"{g['seconds_per_step']:.0f} s/step  {g['prompt_per_step'] / 1e3:.0f}k prompt/step")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Betaflight build backend (runs in WSL): build a custom board config for an in-tree Betaflight target.

A Betaflight project keeps its board definition at `betaflight/configs/<BOARD>/config.h` (written by the agent
from the imported schematic). The build uses a pinned Betaflight release checked out in the WSL home, its own
toolchain (`make arm_sdk_install`), and for RP2350 targets the Pico SDK + picotool, which needs CMake; a portable
CMake is fetched into the user's home so no sudo is needed. Nothing is installed system-wide.
"""

import re
import shutil
import threading
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

from embedforge.core.logger import logger
from embedforge.toolchain import wsl
from embedforge.toolchain.pio import parse_diagnostics

LineSink = Optional[Callable[[str], None]]

BF_TAG = "2026.6.2"
BF_REPO = "https://github.com/betaflight/betaflight.git"
CMAKE_VERSION = "3.31.6"
HOME = "$HOME/.embedforge"
BF_DIR = f"{HOME}/betaflight-{BF_TAG}"
TOOLS = f"{HOME}/tools"
_TARGET_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Z0-9_]{3,24}$")


def available_targets() -> List[str]:
    """In-tree MCU targets of the pinned checkout (what FC_TARGET_MCU may name), e.g. RP2350B, STM32F405."""
    code, lines, _ = wsl.run(targets_script(), None, 120)
    return sorted({ln.strip() for ln in lines if _TARGET_RE.match(ln.strip())}) if code == 0 else []


def explain_undefined(symbols: List[str], limit: int = 3) -> Dict[str, str]:
    """For linker 'undefined reference to X': where X is defined in the Betaflight source and which #if guards it,
    e.g. 'pico_msc_active is defined in src/platform/PICO/usb/usb_msc_pico.c:135 only under #ifdef USE_USB_MSC'."""
    syms = [s for s in dict.fromkeys(symbols) if re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z_]\w{2,80}", s)][:limit]
    if not syms:
        return {}
    pat = "|".join(syms)
    code, lines, _ = wsl.run(f"cd {BF_DIR} && grep -rnwE --include=*.c '({pat})' src/main src/platform 2>/dev/null "
                             f"| grep -vE ':[0-9]+:\\s*(extern|//|\\*)' | head -40", None, 120)
    out: Dict[str, str] = {}
    for ln in lines if code in (0, 1) else []:
        m = re.match(r"([^:]+):(\d+):(.*)$", ln)
        if not m:
            continue
        path, num, src = m.group(1), int(m.group(2)), m.group(3)
        sym = next((s for s in syms if s not in out and re.match(rf"^\w[\w\s\*]*\b{s}\s*(\(|=|;|\[)", src.strip())), None)
        if not sym:
            continue
        c2, head, _ = wsl.run(f"cd {BF_DIR} && sed -n '1,{num}p' {wsl.q(path)}", None, 60)
        stack: List[str] = []
        for h in head if c2 == 0 else []:
            hs = h.strip()
            if re.match(r"#\s*if", hs):
                stack.append(hs)
            elif re.match(r"#\s*endif", hs) and stack:
                stack.pop()
            elif re.match(r"#\s*el(se|if)", hs) and stack:
                stack[-1] = f"{stack[-1]} … {hs}"
        guard = " and ".join(stack[-2:])  # the innermost conditions are the ones a config switches
        out[sym] = (f"{sym} is defined in {path}:{num}" + (f" only under {guard}" if guard else "")
                    + (" — your config must not #undef/omit that" if guard else ""))
    return out


def target_for_part(part: str, targets: List[str]) -> Optional[str]:
    """The in-tree target for an MCU name or full part number: exact target, RP2354A/B (RP2350 with stacked flash)
    -> RP2350A/B, or the longest target that prefixes the part (STM32F405RGT6 -> STM32F405)."""
    p = re.sub(r"[^A-Z0-9]", "", (part or "").upper())
    if not p:
        return None
    if p in targets:
        return p
    rp = re.fullmatch(r"RP235([04])([AB])\w*", p)
    if rp and f"RP2350{rp.group(2)}" in targets:
        return f"RP2350{rp.group(2)}"
    pref = [t for t in targets if p.startswith(t) and len(t) >= 6]
    return max(pref, key=len) if pref else None


def setup_script() -> str:
    """Idempotent: Betaflight checkout, portable CMake, Arm GCC, Pico SDK and picotool."""
    return f"""set -e
mkdir -p {HOME} {TOOLS}
if [ ! -d {BF_DIR}/.git ]; then
  echo "== Cloning Betaflight {BF_TAG}"
  git clone --depth 1 --branch {BF_TAG} {BF_REPO} {BF_DIR}
fi
CM={TOOLS}/cmake-{CMAKE_VERSION}-linux-x86_64
if [ ! -x $CM/bin/cmake ]; then
  echo "== Fetching portable CMake {CMAKE_VERSION}"
  cd {TOOLS}
  base=https://github.com/Kitware/CMake/releases/download/v{CMAKE_VERSION}
  curl -fsSL -o cmake.tgz $base/cmake-{CMAKE_VERSION}-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
  curl -fsSL -o cmake.sha $base/cmake-{CMAKE_VERSION}-SHA-256.txt
  want=$(grep "cmake-{CMAKE_VERSION}-linux-x86_64.tar.gz" cmake.sha | cut -d' ' -f1)
  got=$(sha256sum cmake.tgz | cut -d' ' -f1)
  [ "$want" = "$got" ] || {{ echo "CMake checksum mismatch"; exit 1; }}
  tar xzf cmake.tgz && rm -f cmake.tgz cmake.sha
fi
export PATH=$CM/bin:$PATH
cd {BF_DIR}
echo "== Arm toolchain"; make arm_sdk_install
echo "== Pico SDK"; make pico_sdk
echo "== picotool"; make picotool_install
if [ ! -d src/config/configs ]; then echo "== Board configs (reference)"; make configs; fi
echo "== Setup complete"
"""


def setup_done_script() -> str:
    cm = f"{TOOLS}/cmake-{CMAKE_VERSION}-linux-x86_64/bin/cmake"
    return f"[ -d {BF_DIR}/.git ] && [ -x {cm} ] && [ -d {BF_DIR}/src/config/configs ] && ls {BF_DIR}/tools/picotool/picotool >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo READY"


def is_ready() -> bool:
    code, lines, _ = wsl.run(setup_done_script(), None, 120)
    return code == 0 and "READY" in lines


def reference_configs(target: str, limit: int = 12) -> List[str]:
    """Official board configs (betaflight/config repo) built for the same MCU target — real examples to follow."""
    if not _TARGET_RE.match(target or ""):
        return []
    script = (f"cd {BF_DIR} && grep -rlE '^\\s*#\\s*define\\s+FC_TARGET_MCU\\s+{target}\\b' src/config/configs "
              f"--include=config.h 2>/dev/null | sort | head -{int(limit)}")
    code, lines, _ = wsl.run(script, None, 120)
    return [f"bf:{ln.strip()}" for ln in lines if ln.strip().endswith("config.h")] if code == 0 else []


_BF_PATH_RE = re.compile(r"^bf:(src/[A-Za-z0-9_./\-]+)$")


def search(pattern: str, limit: int = 40) -> List[str]:
    """grep -E over the pinned Betaflight source and board configs; results are 'bf:<path>:<line>: <text>'."""
    script = (f"cd {BF_DIR} && grep -rnE --include=*.h --include=*.c -e {wsl.q(pattern)} src/main src/platform/PICO "
              f"src/platform/common src/config/configs 2>/dev/null | head -{int(limit)} | cut -c1-220")
    code, lines, _ = wsl.run(script, None, 180)
    return [f"bf:{ln}" for ln in lines if ln.strip()] if code in (0, 1) else []


def read_file(path: str, start: int = 1, end: int = 160) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    m = _BF_PATH_RE.match(path.strip())
    if not m or ".." in m.group(1):
        return None
    start, end = max(1, int(start)), max(int(start), min(int(end), int(start) + 240))
    code, lines, _ = wsl.run(f"cd {BF_DIR} && wc -l < {wsl.q(m.group(1))} && sed -n '{start},{end}p' {wsl.q(m.group(1))}", None, 120)
    if code != 0 or not lines:
        return None
    total = int(lines[0]) if lines[0].strip().isdigit() else 0
    body = lines[1:]
    return {"path": path, "start": start, "end": start + len(body) - 1, "total_lines": total,
            "text": "\n".join(f"{start + i}: {t}" for i, t in enumerate(body))}


def build_script(config_dir_wsl: str, board: str, target: str = "") -> str:
    """One shared checkout serves every project, and its objects are keyed by board name only. So: objects built from
    another project's config are wiped first (make's dependency files point at THAT project's config.h and would
    happily reuse them), and previous firmware outputs are deleted so only this make's results can be copied back."""
    objdir = f"obj/main/{target}_{board}" if target else ""
    stamp = f"{objdir}/.embedforge_config_dir" if objdir else ""
    guard = (f"""if [ -d {wsl.q(objdir)} ] && [ "$(cat {wsl.q(stamp)} 2>/dev/null)" != {wsl.q(config_dir_wsl)} ]; then
  echo "== Objects for {board} were built from another project: cleaning them"
  rm -rf {wsl.q(objdir)}
fi
rm -f obj/main/betaflight_{target}_{board}.elf obj/main/betaflight_{target}_{board}.map obj/betaflight_{BF_TAG}_{target}_{board}.*
mkdir -p {wsl.q(objdir)} && printf %s {wsl.q(config_dir_wsl)} > {wsl.q(stamp)}
""" if objdir else "")
    # exact output names: a glob like obj/*_RP2354B.uf2 would also match another project's ..._CUSTOM_RP2354B.uf2
    outs = (f'"$PWD"/obj/betaflight_{BF_TAG}_{target}_{board}.uf2 "$PWD"/obj/betaflight_{BF_TAG}_{target}_{board}.hex '
            f'"$PWD"/obj/betaflight_{BF_TAG}_{target}_{board}.bin' if target else
            f'"$PWD"/obj/*_{board}.uf2 "$PWD"/obj/*_{board}.hex "$PWD"/obj/*_{board}.bin')
    elf = f'"$PWD"/obj/main/betaflight_{target}_{board}.elf' if target else f'"$PWD"/obj/main/*_{board}.elf'
    return f"""set -e
export PATH={TOOLS}/cmake-{CMAKE_VERSION}-linux-x86_64/bin:$PATH
cd {BF_DIR}
{guard}make CONFIG={wsl.q(board)} CONFIG_DIR={wsl.q(config_dir_wsl)} -j"$(nproc)"
echo "== OUTPUTS"
ls -1 {outs} 2>/dev/null || true
ls -1 {elf} 2>/dev/null || true
"""


def targets_script() -> str:
    return f"ls -1d {BF_DIR}/src/platform/*/target/*/ 2>/dev/null | xargs -n1 basename | grep -v '^common$'"


@dataclass

MANUFACTURER_ID = "CUST"   # Betaflight's reserved manufacturer id for homebrew boards


def config_files(project_dir: Path) -> List[Path]:
    """config.h files in either layout: configs/<BOARD>/ or configs/<MANUFACTURER_ID>/<BOARD>/."""
    base = Path(project_dir) / "betaflight" / "configs"
    if not base.is_dir():
        return []
    return sorted(set(base.glob("*/config.h")) | set(base.glob("*/*/config.h")))


def configs(project_dir: Path) -> List[str]:
    return [p.parent.name for p in config_files(project_dir)]


def write_flash_override(board_dir: Path, flash_mb: int) -> List[str]:
    """Per-board flash size for RP2350 targets (Betaflight 2026.6+), in the exact form the official
    RASPBERRY_PI_UAVFC config uses. Generated from fixed templates — never model-written, since config.mk is make code."""
    if flash_mb not in (2, 4, 8, 16):
        raise ValueError("flash_mb must be 2, 4, 8 or 16")
    kb, nbytes = flash_mb * 1024, flash_mb * 1024 * 1024
    font = "0" if flash_mb <= 2 else "16K"   # FB_OSD font space; a 2 MB part cannot spare it
    (board_dir / "config.mk").write_text(
        "# Generated by EmbedForge: flash size for this board (see pico_flash_mem.ld).\n"
        f"TARGET_FLASH_SIZE = {kb}\n"
        "PICO_FLASH_DEFINES = \\\n"
        "                   -DPICO_FLASH_SPI_CLKDIV=2 \\\n"
        f"                   -DPICO_FLASH_SIZE_BYTES={nbytes} \\\n"
        "                   -DPICO_BOOT_STAGE2_CHOOSE_W25Q080=1\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (board_dir / "pico_flash_mem.ld").write_text(
        "/* Generated by EmbedForge: primary flash and FB_OSD font allocation for this board. */\n"
        f"PRIMARY_FLASH_LENGTH = {flash_mb}M;\nFONT_LENGTH = {font};\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return ["config.mk", "pico_flash_mem.ld"]


def config_target(config_h: Path) -> str:
    m = re.search(r"^\s*#\s*define\s+FC_TARGET_MCU\s+(\w+)", config_h.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore"), re.M)
    return m.group(1) if m else ""


def setup(on_line: LineSink = None, timeout_s: int = 3600) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    ok, detail = wsl.available()
    if not ok:
        return {"ok": False, "error": detail}
    code, lines, timed_out = wsl.run(setup_script(), on_line, timeout_s)
    good = code == 0 and not timed_out and any("Setup complete" in ln for ln in lines)
    logger.log_event("BETAFLIGHT_SETUP", f"ok={good}")
    return {"ok": good, "error": "" if good else "\n".join(lines[-25:])}


_MEM_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(FLASH|FLASH1|RAM|SRAM\w*|MAIN_RAM)\s*:\s*(\d+)\s*([KMG]?B)\s+(\d+)\s*([KMG]?B)", re.I)


def _bytes(n: str, unit: str) -> int:
    return int(n) * {"B": 1, "KB": 1024, "MB": 1024 * 1024, "GB": 1024 ** 3}[unit.upper()]


_LINT_DEFINE = re.compile(r"^\s*#\s*define\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\b[ \t]*(.*?)\s*$")
_LINT_TAG = re.compile(r"FACT-[^\s*/,;)]+")


def _strip_c_comments(text: str) -> List[str]:
    """Per-line code with /* */ and // comments removed (keeps line numbering)."""
    out, in_block = [], False
    for raw in text.split("\n"):
        code, i = "", 0
        while i < len(raw):
            if in_block:
                end = raw.find("*/", i)
                if end < 0:
                    i = len(raw)
                else:
                    in_block, i = False, end + 2
            elif raw.startswith("/*", i):
                in_block, i = True, i + 2
            elif raw.startswith("//", i):
                break
            else:
                code += raw[i]
                i += 1
        out.append(code)
    return out


def lint_config(text: str, board: str, target: str) -> Dict[str, List[str]]:
    """Cheap checks on a Betaflight config.h before running make. 'errors' would certainly fail the build."""
    errors: List[str] = []
    warnings: List[str] = []
    code = _strip_c_comments(text)
    depth, opened = 0, []
    defines: Dict[str, Tuple[str, int]] = {}
    gpio_users: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
    for n, line in enumerate(code, start=1):
        s = line.strip()
        if re.match(r"#\s*if(n?def)?\b", s):
            depth += 1
            opened.append(n)
        elif re.match(r"#\s*endif\b", s):
            if depth == 0:
                errors.append(f"line {n}: #endif without a matching #if (configs use '#pragma once', not include guards)")
            else:
                depth -= 1
                opened.pop()
        m = _LINT_DEFINE.match(line)
        if m:
            name, value = m.group(1), m.group(2).strip()
            if name in defines and defines[name][0] != value:
                warnings.append(f"line {n}: {name} redefined ('{defines[name][0]}' on line {defines[name][1]}, now '{value}')")
            defines[name] = (value, n)
            pm = re.fullmatch(r"PA(\d{1,2})", value)
            if name.endswith("_PIN") and pm:
                gpio_users.setdefault(pm.group(1), []).append(name)
    for n in opened:
        errors.append(f"line {n}: #if/#ifdef without a matching #endif")
    if "HSE_VALUE" in defines:
        errors.append(f"line {defines['HSE_VALUE'][1]}: do not define HSE_VALUE in a config (the target's build sets it"
                      + ("" if (target or "").startswith("RP") else "; an external crystal is declared with SYSTEM_HSE_MHZ") + ")")
    if "ADC_ESC_CURRENT_PIN" in defines:
        errors.append(f"line {defines['ADC_ESC_CURRENT_PIN'][1]}: ADC_ESC_CURRENT_PIN is not a Betaflight define; the "
                      "current-sensor ADC input is ADC_CURR_PIN")
    for name, (value, n) in defines.items():  # an instance needs that bus's pins
        im = re.fullmatch(r"\(?(SPI|I2CDEV_)(\d)\)?", value)
        if not im or not name.endswith(("_SPI_INSTANCE", "_I2C_INSTANCE")):
            continue
        bus = f"SPI{im.group(2)}" if im.group(1) == "SPI" else f"I2C{im.group(2)}"
        need = ["SCK", "SDI", "SDO"] if bus.startswith("SPI") else ["SDA", "SCL"]
        missing = [f"{bus}_{p}_PIN" for p in need if f"{bus}_{p}_PIN" not in defines]
        if missing:
            errors.append(f"line {n}: {name} is {value}, but {', '.join(missing)} {'is' if len(missing) == 1 else 'are'} not "
                          f"defined — use the bus whose pins you defined")
    tgt = defines.get("FC_TARGET_MCU", ("", 0))[0]
    if not tgt:
        errors.append(f"missing '#define FC_TARGET_MCU {target}'")
    elif target and tgt != target:
        errors.append(f"line {defines['FC_TARGET_MCU'][1]}: FC_TARGET_MCU is {tgt}, but this project's target is {target}")
    bn = defines.get("BOARD_NAME", ("", 0))[0]
    if not bn:
        errors.append(f"missing '#define BOARD_NAME {board}'")
    elif board and bn != board:
        errors.append(f"line {defines['BOARD_NAME'][1]}: BOARD_NAME is {bn}, but the config directory is {board}")
    if not defines.get("MANUFACTURER_ID"):
        errors.append(f"missing '#define MANUFACTURER_ID {MANUFACTURER_ID}'")
    for name, (value, n) in defines.items():  # bus instances are enum values, not peripheral names
        if name.endswith("_I2C_INSTANCE") and not re.fullmatch(r"\(?I2CDEV_\d\)?", value):
            fix = re.sub(r"^\(?I2C(\d)\)?$", r"I2CDEV_\1", value)
            errors.append(f"line {n}: {name} is '{value}', but I2C instances are I2CDEV_n" + (f" (here {fix})" if fix != value else ""))
        elif name.endswith("_SPI_INSTANCE") and not re.fullmatch(r"\(?SPI\d\)?", value):
            errors.append(f"line {n}: {name} is '{value}', but SPI instances are SPIn (e.g. SPI0)")
    undefs = re.findall(r"^\s*#\s*undef\s+(USE_\w+)", text, re.M)
    if undefs:
        warnings.append(f"#undef {', '.join(sorted(set(undefs))[:8])}: removing features the target enables often breaks the "
                        "link (e.g. USE_USB_MSC). Only #undef what a reference config for this target also removes.")
    if not re.search(r"^\s*#\s*pragma\s+once\b", text, re.M):
        warnings.append("no '#pragma once' at the top (every Betaflight config starts with it)")
    bad_tags: Dict[str, List[int]] = {}
    for n, raw in enumerate(text.split("\n"), start=1):
        for tag in _LINT_TAG.findall(raw):
            tag = tag.rstrip(":;,.")
            if not re.fullmatch(r"FACT-\d{3,}", tag):
                bad_tags.setdefault(tag, []).append(n)
    for tag, lines in bad_tags.items():  # compiles fine, but verify rejects it: warn now, don't block the build
        where = ", ".join(map(str, lines[:8])) + (f" (+{len(lines) - 8} more)" if len(lines) > 8 else "")
        warnings.append(f"line{'s' if len(lines) > 1 else ''} {where}: '{tag}' is not a fact id — use the FACT-nnn ids "
                        "record_board_pins/record_fact returned (verify fails on it)")
    for gpio, names in gpio_users.items():
        if len(names) > 1:
            warnings.append(f"PA{gpio} is used by {', '.join(names)}")
    return {"errors": errors, "warnings": warnings}


_KNOWN_NAMES: Dict[str, bool] = {}   # define name -> referenced by the pinned Betaflight source (fixed per release)
_ALWAYS_KNOWN = {"FC_TARGET_MCU", "BOARD_NAME", "MANUFACTURER_ID"}


def unknown_defines(names: List[str]) -> Optional[List[str]]:
    """Names that no Betaflight source file references (so defining them has no effect), e.g. MOTOR0_PIN or
    USE_GYRO_BMI270. None when the source cannot be searched."""
    todo = sorted({n for n in names if n not in _KNOWN_NAMES and n not in _ALWAYS_KNOWN
                   and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{2,63}", n)})
    if todo:
        args = " ".join(f"-e {n}" for n in todo)
        # src/main + src/platform + mk: the code that consumes config defines (not src/config, other boards' configs)
        code, lines, _ = wsl.run(f"cd {BF_DIR} && grep -rhowF --include=*.c --include=*.h --include=*.mk {args} "
                                 f"src/main src/platform mk 2>/dev/null | sort -u", None, 180)
        if code not in (0, 1):
            return None
        found = {ln.strip() for ln in lines}
        for n in todo:
            _KNOWN_NAMES[n] = n in found
    return [n for n in names if n not in _ALWAYS_KNOWN and _KNOWN_NAMES.get(n) is False]


_FLASH_PART = re.compile(r"W25|GD25|M25P|IS25|MX25|AT25|XT25|BY25|ZD25", re.I)
_SD_PART = re.compile(r"\bSD\b|SD-?CARD|MICRO\s*SD|\bTF\b|TF-?CARD", re.I)


def board_consistency(text: str, board: Any) -> List[Tuple[str, str, int, str, str]]:
    """Config claims the schematic contradicts (verify ERRORs): one GPIO driving two defines, and storage devices the
    board does not have (typical when a reference config's hardware is copied)."""
    out: List[Tuple[str, str, int, str, str]] = []
    users: Dict[str, List[Tuple[str, int]]] = {}
    defines: Dict[str, int] = {}
    for n, line in enumerate(_strip_c_comments(text), start=1):
        m = re.match(r"\s*#\s*define\s+(\w+)(?:\s+(\S+))?", line)
        if not m:
            continue
        defines.setdefault(m.group(1), n)
        pm = re.fullmatch(r"PA(\d{1,2})", m.group(2) or "")
        if m.group(1).endswith("_PIN") and pm:
            users.setdefault(pm.group(1), []).append((m.group(1), n))
    for gpio, names in users.items():
        if len({x for x, _ in names}) > 1:
            out.append(("ERROR", "PIN_USED_TWICE", names[1][1], f"PA{gpio} is used by {', '.join(x for x, _ in names)}.",
                        "One GPIO drives one function: keep the define its schematic net belongs to and remove the others."))
    if board is None:
        return out
    parts = " ".join(f"{p.value} {p.mpn} {p.footprint}" for p in board.parts.values())
    norm_parts = re.sub(r"[^A-Z0-9 ]", "", parts.upper())
    flash = [d for d in defines if d.startswith("USE_FLASH_") or d == "FLASH_CS_PIN"]
    if flash and not _FLASH_PART.search(parts):
        out.append(("ERROR", "DEVICE_NOT_ON_BOARD", defines[flash[0]], f"{flash[0]} enables an SPI flash chip, but the schematic has none.",
                    "Remove the flash defines (and BLACKBOX_DEVICE_FLASH); they were probably copied from a reference config."))
    if "BLACKBOX_DEVICE_SDCARD" in text and not _SD_PART.search(parts):
        out.append(("ERROR", "DEVICE_NOT_ON_BOARD", 0, "BLACKBOX_DEVICE_SDCARD is set, but the schematic has no SD socket.",
                    "Remove the SD card blackbox setting."))
    # chip drivers: USE_ACCGYRO_BMI270, USE_BARO_BMP388, USE_GYRO_SPI_ICM42688P, USE_MAX7456 ... need that chip on the board
    for d, n in defines.items():
        m = re.fullmatch(r"USE_(?:ACCGYRO|ACC|GYRO|BARO|MAG|FLASH)(?:_SPI|_I2C)?_([A-Z][A-Z0-9]{3,})", d)
        chip = m.group(1) if m else ("MAX7456" if d == "USE_MAX7456" else "")
        if not chip or chip in ("CHIP", "SPI", "I2C") or (m and d.startswith("USE_FLASH")):
            continue
        alts = {chip[:6]} | ({"AT7456"} if chip == "MAX7456" else set())
        if not any(a in norm_parts.replace(" ", "") for a in alts):
            out.append(("ERROR", "DEVICE_NOT_ON_BOARD", n, f"{d} enables a {chip}, but no such chip is on the schematic.",
                        "Enable only drivers for chips on this board (check the Parts list); remove this define."))
    # bus <-> device: a device's chip select and its bus clock must reach the same chip
    def gpio_of(name: str) -> Optional[int]:
        m = re.search(rf"^\s*#\s*define\s+{name}\s+PA(\d{{1,2}})\b", text, re.M)
        return int(m.group(1)) if m else None

    def devices(gpio: Optional[int]) -> set:
        if gpio is None:
            return set()
        _, refs = board.gpio_net(gpio)
        return {r for r in refs if not re.match(r"^(R|C|L|FB|TP)\d", r, re.I)}

    for dev, cs_name, inst_name in (("gyro", "GYRO_1_CS_PIN", "GYRO_1_SPI_INSTANCE"), ("gyro 2", "GYRO_2_CS_PIN", "GYRO_2_SPI_INSTANCE"),
                                    ("SD card", "SDCARD_SPI_CS_PIN", "SDCARD_SPI_INSTANCE"),
                                    ("OSD", "MAX7456_SPI_CS_PIN", "MAX7456_SPI_INSTANCE"), ("flash", "FLASH_CS_PIN", "FLASH_SPI_INSTANCE")):
        im = re.search(rf"^\s*#\s*define\s+{inst_name}\s+\(?SPI(\d)\)?", text, re.M)
        if not im:
            continue
        cs = gpio_of(cs_name)
        if cs is None:
            if dev == "SD card" or dev == "gyro":
                out.append(("ERROR", "BUS_DEVICE_MISMATCH", defines.get(inst_name, 0), f"{inst_name} is set but {cs_name} is not defined.",
                            f"Define {cs_name} with the {dev}'s chip-select pin from the schematic, or remove the {dev}."))
            continue
        on_cs, on_sck = devices(cs), devices(gpio_of(f"SPI{im.group(1)}_SCK_PIN"))
        if on_cs and not (on_cs & on_sck):
            out.append(("ERROR", "BUS_DEVICE_MISMATCH", defines.get(inst_name, 0),
                        f"{cs_name} PA{cs} goes to {', '.join(sorted(on_cs))}, but SPI{im.group(1)}_SCK_PIN does not reach that part.",
                        f"Use the SPI bus whose SCK/SDI/SDO pins are wired to {', '.join(sorted(on_cs))} for {inst_name}."))
    if "USE_SDCARD" in defines and "SDCARD_SPI_INSTANCE" not in defines:
        out.append(("ERROR", "BUS_DEVICE_MISMATCH", defines["USE_SDCARD"], "USE_SDCARD is set without SDCARD_SPI_INSTANCE and SDCARD_SPI_CS_PIN.",
                    "Give the SD card its bus and chip select from the schematic, or remove USE_SDCARD."))
    # wired MCU pins the config does not use (a warning: the finish summary must say what was left out and why)
    used = {int(g) for g in users}
    unused = []
    for m in board.mcus()[:1]:
        for pin in m.pins.values():
            g = re.match(r"GPIO(\d+)", pin.name or "", re.I)
            if g and pin.net and int(g.group(1)) not in used:
                net, refs = board.gpio_net(int(g.group(1)))
                real = [r for r in refs if not re.match(r"^(R|C|L|FB)\d", r, re.I)]
                if real:
                    unused.append(f"GPIO{int(g.group(1))} ({net} -> {', '.join(real[:3])})")
    if unused:
        out.append(("WARNING", "WIRED_PIN_UNUSED", 0, f"Wired MCU pins not used by the config: {'; '.join(sorted(unused)[:16])}.",
                    "Configure each function the board wires (e.g. GYRO_1_EXTI_PIN, ADC_CURR_PIN, SD card pins), or say in the "
                    "finish summary why it is left out."))
    return out


def pin_summary(text: str) -> List[str]:
    """'NAME = PAn [FACT-nnn]' for each pin define, so the model can see its pin map without re-reading the file."""
    out = []
    for raw in text.split("\n"):
        m = re.match(r"\s*#\s*define\s+(\w+_PIN)\s+(PA\d+|NONE)\b(.*)", raw)
        if m:
            tags = re.findall(r"FACT-\d{3,}", m.group(3))
            out.append(f"{m.group(1)} = {m.group(2)}" + (f" [{', '.join(tags)}]" if tags else " [untagged]"))
    return out


_BUILD_LOCK = threading.Lock()  # one checkout: concurrent makes would share obj/ and the config symlinks


def build(project_dir: Path, on_line: LineSink = None, timeout_s: int = 3600, board_hint: str = "") -> BFResult:
    """Build the project's Betaflight config in WSL and copy the outputs into the project (serialised)."""
    if not _BUILD_LOCK.acquire(blocking=False):
        if on_line:
            on_line("Another Betaflight build is running — waiting for it to finish…")
        _BUILD_LOCK.acquire()
    try:
        return _build(project_dir, on_line, timeout_s, board_hint)
    finally:
        _BUILD_LOCK.release()


def _build(project_dir: Path, on_line: LineSink, timeout_s: int, board_hint: str) -> BFResult:
    t0 = time.time()
    project_dir = Path(project_dir).resolve()
    files = config_files(project_dir)
    if not files:
        return BFResult(ok=False, error="No betaflight/configs/CUST/<BOARD>/config.h in this project.")
    files = [f for f in files if f.parent.name == board_hint] or files
    board = files[0].parent.name
    if not wsl.safe_name(board):
        return BFResult(ok=False, board=board, error="Board name must be letters, digits, '_' or '-'.")
    target = config_target(files[0])
    lint = lint_config(files[0].read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore"), board, target)
    if lint["errors"]:
        from embedforge.toolchain.pio import Diagnostic
        rel = str(files[0].relative_to(project_dir)).replace("\\", "/")
        diags = []
        for e in lint["errors"]:
            m = re.match(r"line (\d+): (.*)", e)
            diags.append(Diagnostic("error", rel, int(m.group(1)) if m else 0, m.group(2) if m else e))
        return BFResult(ok=False, board=board, target=target, diagnostics=diags,
                        error="Config check failed before make (no build was run).")
    ok, detail = wsl.available()
    if not ok:
        return BFResult(ok=False, board=board, target=target, error=detail)
    known = available_targets()
    if target not in known:
        return BFResult(ok=False, board=board, target=target,
                        error=f"config.h must '#define FC_TARGET_MCU <target>' naming an in-tree Betaflight {BF_TAG} target: "
                              + (", ".join(known) or "(run Betaflight setup first)"))
    if on_line:
        on_line(f"$ make CONFIG={board}   (Betaflight {BF_TAG}, target {target}, in WSL)")
    code, lines, timed_out = wsl.run(build_script(wsl.to_wsl_path(str(project_dir / "betaflight")), board, target), on_line, timeout_s)
    res = BFResult(ok=code == 0 and not timed_out, board=board, target=target, duration_s=round(time.time() - t0, 1))
    res.diagnostics = parse_diagnostics(lines)
    proj_wsl = wsl.to_wsl_path(str(project_dir)).rstrip("/") + "/"
    for d in res.diagnostics:  # report project files relative to the project, like PlatformIO builds do
        if d.file.startswith(proj_wsl):
            d.file = d.file[len(proj_wsl):]
        elif d.file.startswith(("/home/", "./src/", "src/")):
            d.file = "betaflight-src:" + d.file.split("/betaflight-" + BF_TAG + "/")[-1].lstrip("./")
    for ln in lines:
        m = _MEM_RE.match(ln)
        if m:
            used, total = _bytes(m.group(2), m.group(3)), _bytes(m.group(4), m.group(5))
            if m.group(1).upper().startswith("FLASH"):
                res.flash_used, res.flash_total = used, total
            elif not res.ram_total:
                res.ram_used, res.ram_total = used, total
    res.log_tail = "\n".join(lines[-60:])
    undefined = [m.group(1) for d in res.diagnostics for m in [re.search(r"undefined reference to `([^']+)'", d.message)] if m]
    if undefined:  # linker errors have no source line: say where the symbol lives and what guards it
        why = explain_undefined(undefined)
        for d in res.diagnostics:
            m = re.search(r"undefined reference to `([^']+)'", d.message)
            if m and m.group(1) in why:
                d.message = f"{d.message} [{why[m.group(1)]}]"
    if timed_out:
        res.error = f"Build timed out after {timeout_s}s."
    if res.ok:
        out_dir = project_dir / ".pio" / "betaflight"   # managed build folder (not editable by the agent)
        out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        tail = lines[lines.index("== OUTPUTS") + 1:] if "== OUTPUTS" in lines else []
        for wpath in tail:
            wpath = wpath.strip()
            ext = wpath.rsplit(".", 1)[-1].lower() if "." in wpath else ""
            if ext not in ("uf2", "hex", "bin", "elf"):
                continue
            c2, out, _ = wsl.run(f"wslpath -w {wsl.q(wpath)}", None, 60)
            win = out[-1].strip() if c2 == 0 and out else ""
            # the checkout lives in the Linux filesystem: copy through \\wsl$ into the project
            if win:
                dst = out_dir / Path(wpath).name
                try:
                    shutil.copy2(win, dst)
                    res.artifacts[ext] = str(dst)
                except OSError as e:
                    res.error = f"Built, but could not copy {wpath}: {e}"
        if "hex" not in res.artifacts and "elf" in res.artifacts:  # RP2350 builds make .uf2/.elf; derive the .hex
            from embedforge.toolchain.fwformat import elf_to_hex
            hex_path = Path(res.artifacts["elf"]).with_suffix(".hex")
            if elf_to_hex(Path(res.artifacts["elf"]), hex_path):
                res.artifacts["hex"] = str(hex_path)
        if not res.artifacts:
            res.ok = False
            res.error = res.error or "Build finished but no firmware files were found in obj/."
    elif not res.error and not res.diagnostics:
        res.error = "Build failed; see log tail."
    logger.log_event("BETAFLIGHT_BUILD", f"{board}/{target}: ok={res.ok} artifacts={list(res.artifacts)}")
    return res
